# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 6 tokens; Borders and rings — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 12 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 9 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens; Duration — 4 tokens; Easing — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #faf7fd);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #17102a);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #faf7fd;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #faf7fd | #17102a | Page background. |
| `--surface-raised` | #ffffff | #221838 | Cards, fields, popovers. |
| `--surface-sunken` | #f1eaf8 | #110b20 | Wells, table headers, grouped filters. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #1f1233);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #f4eefc);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #1f1233;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #1f1233 | #f4eefc | Headings and body text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. |
| `--ink-muted` | #5b4b73 | #b9a9d3 | Secondary text and placeholders on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. Never on brand or band fills. |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css

/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */

/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #ffffff;
```

| token | light | dark | usage |

| `--on-brand` | #ffffff | #1a0f33 | Text and icons on brand and brand-hover. |
| `--on-band` | #ffffff | #f4eefc | Headings and body on band and band-alt. |
| `--on-band-muted` | #d9c8f7 | #cdbbea | Secondary text on band and band-alt. |
| `--on-accent` | #2a1740 | #2a1740 | Text on accent. |
| `--on-success` | #ffffff | #06251f | Text on a solid success fill. |
| `--on-danger` | #ffffff | #3a0b08 | Text on a solid danger fill. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--line, #e3d8f2);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--line, #33264f);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #e3d8f2;
```

### Tokens (12)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--line` | #e3d8f2 | #33264f | Decorative hairlines between rows and inside cards. Never the only edge of a control; use border-strong. |
| `--brand` | #6d3fc4 | #b794f6 | Primary button fill, links, active states. Text on it is on-brand. |
| `--brand-hover` | #5a2fae | #cdb2fa | Hover and pressed fill of brand. |
| `--brand-strong` | #4a2a99 | #d6c2fb | Text and icons on brand-soft; large brand blocks on the cover. |
| `--brand-soft` | #ece3fb | #33244f | Chip and badge fill, selected row, icon tile background. Text on it is brand-strong. |
| `--band` | #3b1f78 | #2b1a5e | Full-width hero and call-to-action bands, image placeholders. Text on it is on-band. |
| `--band-alt` | #4b2a99 | #35206f | Second band tone for stacked angled sections. Text on it is on-band. |
| `--accent` | #f2b441 | #f2b441 | Sand-gold highlight: price emphasis, awaiting-deposit status, moon and star shapes. Text on it is on-accent. |
| `--success` | #0f7b6c | #5fd1bd | Confirmed state: outline and text on surface-raised, always with a check icon and the word. |
| `--danger` | #b3261e | #ff9a92 | Declined state and field errors on surface-raised, always with an x icon and the word. |
| `--focus` | #3b1f78 | #e6d4ff | Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px to 3px offset, on every surface. |
| `--overlay` | rgba(23, 16, 42, 0.55) | rgba(23, 16, 42, 0.55) | Scrim over a camp photo so on-band text stays readable; check the photo. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 56px/68px "Readex Pro", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-xl);
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-xl` | `.display-xl`, `--text-display-xl` | 56px / 68px | 700 | `display` | Hero headline, one per page. |
| `display-lg` | `.display-lg`, `--text-display-lg` | 40px / 52px | 700 | `display` | Section headline on bands. |
| `h2` | `.h2`, `--text-h2` | 28px / 40px | 600 | `display` | Section titles. |
| `h3` | `.h3`, `--text-h3` | 20px / 32px | 600 | `display` | Card titles. |
| `body-lg` | `.body-lg`, `--text-body-lg` | 18px / 32px | 400 | `sans` | Lead paragraph under a headline. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 28px | 400 | `sans` | Default text. |
| `body-sm` | `.body-sm`, `--text-body-sm` | 14px / 24px | 400 | `sans` | Meta lines, captions, hints. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 13px / 20px | 600 | `sans` | Field labels, badges, button text on small buttons. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `"Readex Pro", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon to text gap. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gap inside buttons and badges. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Gap between meta items. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Field padding, grid gap. |
| `--space-5` | 24px | Card padding, button side padding. |
| `--space-6` | 32px | Gap between cards. |
| `--space-7` | 48px | Gap between blocks inside a section. |
| `--space-8` | 72px | Vertical padding of a section. |
| `--space-9` | 96px | Hero vertical padding. |

## Duration

Motion lengths. All motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--duration-fast: 160ms) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--duration-fast), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--duration-fast` | 160ms | Colour changes, press feedback. |
| `--duration-base` | 280ms | Button lift, field focus, arrow nudge. |
| `--duration-slow` | 560ms | Reveal on entry, card lift. |
| `--duration-hero` | 900ms | Hero entrance and slow image zoom. |

## Easing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--easing-out: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--easing-out), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--easing-out` | cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) | Default: things arriving or lifting. |
| `--easing-spring` | cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) | Small playful overshoot: badges and tick marks only. |
| `--easing-inout` | cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1) | Looping drift of decorative shapes. |
